adjudication.rationale: In `app/assets/javascripts/embed.js`, the iframe URL is constructed via simple concatenation: `iframe.src = discourseUrl + "embed/best?..."`. If `discourseUrl` does not end with `/`, the result becomes malformed (e.g. `https://forum.example.comembed/best...`). The diff shows no normalization (adding a trailing slash) or safer joining, so the embed script’s behavior is fragile and can break depending on how the required global `discourseUrl` is defined by the embedding page.
